thread:
Ava: heads up — staged rollout to eu-1 hit weight oscillation during the traffic shift. Pods in eu-1 returned a bunch of 503s and the splitter kept rebalancing. rolling back the canary now.
Sam: saw that on grafana, redis failovers line up with the first spike. leader flapped across replicas.
Rohit: are the 503s from the app or the proxy? nginx logs show repeated 'upstream response timed out' from the NLB.
Liza: splitter healthchecks started failing when redis leader switched. app tries to fetch prefix cache -> times out -> readiness toggles off -> splitter pulls weight back.
Ava: our gradualCutover cooldown is only 30s right now. autoscaler reacted to CPU dip and scaled in eu pool, so weights moved back and we entered a flip/flop loop.
Marcos: deploy-bot: shift 20% -> 50% -> 20% -> autorevert?
deploy-bot: deploy: traffic-shift/eu-rollout id=ts-1724 status=partial_revert
Sam: checked aws events — no scheduled maintenance. looks like redis replicas had high replication lag around the time of failover.
Rohit: confirmed: replicationLag spiked due to GC pauses on one node. promoting a stable replica manually stopped repeated leader elections.
Liza: proposal: add a post-shift lock + longer cooldown in the splitter and treat cache errors as soft-fail (don’t toggle readiness immediately). also restrict weight steps to smaller increments and add a circuit-breaker threshold.
Ava: agree. quick helm values patch suggestion:
```
cutover:
  cooldownSeconds: 120
  stepPercent: 5
  circuitBreakerErrorsPercent: 10
  postShiftLock: true
```
Rohit: I'll open a TF PR to increase the autoscaler stabilization window and ensure nodepool min=2 during cutovers, plus an alert: Redis replicationLag > 500ms.
Sam: :thumbsup: add a post-deploy smoke that hits the prefix cache and fail the rollout if errors > 5% in 2m.
Liza: I'll update the GitOps chart and add a short runbook for manual promote + rollback steps. runbook: https://wiki/redwood/runbooks/gradual-cutover-redis-fallback
Marcos: doing a quick patch to splitter config, rolling forward one more time with 10% and 2m cooldown — watching metrics.
Ava: metrics look stable after promoting the replica and applying the cooldown. no further failovers. will close after PRs merged.
Rohit: PRs opened: terraform #234 (autoscaler/stabilization), helm #567 (cutover defaults), gitops #890 (splitter-lock + smoke).
Liza: will merge once CI passes and add the runbook link to the PR description.
deploy-bot: CI: all checks passed for helm#567 and gitops#890
Marcos: merging splitter hotfix now.
Ava: thanks all — follow-up: let's add a postmortem note for the rollout runbook and add traffic-shift e2e in our CI job for future canaries.
Sam: noted, I'll file the postmortem doc and link PRs.
